necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea, symptoms that are concerning for underlying arrhythmia in the context of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. To correlate these episodic symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances and guide further management, mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is indicated. This service corresponds to CPT code 93229 and addresses diagnosis codes I49.9 and I34.0.
